segments.name: Home improvement retail
segments.description: An omnichannel home improvement retailer serving DIY and DIFM homeowners, renters, and Pro customers through stores, branches, online, and contact centers.
segments.evidence: Lowe's is an omnichannel retailer whose focus is on helping customers solve problems and fulfill dreams for their homes by providing an excellent customer experience, creating a great place to work for our associates, and improving our communities, which we believe will create long-term, sustainable value for our shareholders.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Lowe's for home improvement products, installation services, and delivery of building materials sold through its stores, branches, online, and contact centers.
revenueModel.evidence: To meet customers' varying needs, we offer a complete line of products for construction, maintenance, repair, remodeling, and decorating.

changes.text: In 2025, Lowe's acquired Foundation Building Materials (FBM) and Artisan Design Group (ADG) to serve larger Pro customers.
changes.evidence: which include our current year acquisitions of Foundation Building Materials (FBM) and Artisan Design Group (ADG).
